sights.n: Sapporo Satoland (サッポロさとらんど)
sights.w: A 74.3 ha agricultural park of flower fields, farm animals and lawns — pick potatoes, onions and corn from mid-June to early November.

sights.n: Hiraoka Park plum grove (平岡公園 梅林)
sights.w: About 1,200 red and white plum trees — one of Sapporo's largest groves — whose May bloom draws some 100,000 visitors and announces spring.

sights.address: Kita 7-jō Nishi 7-chōme, Kita-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: An 1880 rest house built for Emperor Meiji's Hokkaido visit — a Western-style building blended with Japanese rooms; a city-designated cultural property.
